posts.text:
The GOP Tennessee gerrymander is the latest attack on Black voting power.

And we know that Republicans will attempt to do the same in Missouri as soon as they get the chance.

The Democratic Party needs leaders who will fight back against MAGA extremism and use every tool to defend the right to vote before more communities lose their voice.


The Intercept (@theintercept)

With the Supreme Court blessing racial gerrymandering, Tennessee’s GOP rushed to eliminate the state’s only majority-Black

This political moment calls for fighters.

I’m proud to be running for Congress to fight for STL and bring home the federal funding that our communities need to thrive.

Video

No experience needed! Our canvasses start with an on-site training. Free merch and yard signs will be available to those who can show up early! Sign up here to join a canvass tomorrow, Sunday, for another time soon!
mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

TOMORROW: COME CANVASS WITH CORI!

Join Cori and our amazing crew of volunteers to hit the streets at 12:30 PM in North City to connect with neighbors, rally support, and grow our movement one conversation at a time.







Video

Together, we’re building our movement to send a true fighter for STL back to Congress. But we need your help!

Reach us at 👉 Houseparties@coribush.org if you’re interested to learn more.

Want to kick it with Cori, your family, and friends? Now’s your chance!

We’re joining together with voters, community members, and small business owners across St. Louis to host Q&As, meet & greets, and fundraisers for Cori!

I’m committed to going back to Congress to keep delivering for STL and continuing to ensure that our young people, advocates, and nonprofits get the funding they need to keep elevating our communities.

Join our movement here: coribush.org

I had a great time yesterday paying a visit to Youth In Need’s newest location in Spanish Lake!

I’m ecstatic to see the result of the $850,000 in funding that we were able to secure for the Bright Futures Youth Homelessness Prevention project while I represented MO-01.

The people of St. Louis didn’t ask for data centers to come to our communities.

We’re demanding funding for healthcare, education, and true investment in the Northside, not more profits for billionaires and the AI industry.

I’m proud to be running to go back to Congress and keep delivering for the people of STL and put our needs first.

Video

TONIGHT:

Join us for the launch of Conversations with Cori!

Every Thursday, we'll be at a different local business to meet with community members and have real conversations about the issues St. Louis is facing.

If you're a local business owner interested in hosting, we'd love to hear from you! Leave a comment below or reach out to info@coribush.org

Join us tonight at:
Karsyns Soule 2.O
635 Washington Ave. (63101)
5PM-6:30PM

Video

It’s time for Democrats to do what the people demand: fight back against Trump.

If you won’t fight for the healthcare, housing, and education that St. Louis deserves, you aren’t the right person to lead our community.

I’m proud to have been that leader in Congress before, and together, our movement will go back to DC, where I'll be that leader again.

Video

I’m honored to earn the endorsement of USCPR Action.

This political moment calls for leadership that is unafraid to take the necessary steps to stop U.S. military aid to Israel and end our complicity in war crimes, apartheid, and genocide.

I’m proud to be running to go back to Congress to keep standing for justice and to fight for our 1st Amendment rights to organize to end the genocide in Palestine.

On May Day, we rallied with international graduate students and union workers to fight for fair wages, healthcare, the right to safety, fair working conditions, to organize, and so much more.

I’m committed to making sure that the everyday people of St. Louis get everything they deserve.

Together, our movement will go back to Congress and we’ll ensure that our economy works for all of us, not just the wealthy few.

Video

If you are anywhere near St. Louis, join us every Thursday for Conversations with Cori!

We will highlight a different local business while real people ask real questions to The Honorable Cori Bush-Merritts.

If you’re a local business owner, comment your business below so we can highlight you next.

First up:
This Thursday, May 7th @ 5PM
Karsyns Soule 2.O
635 Washington Ave. 63101

I’m relieved that telehealth, mail, and pharmacy access to mifepristone have been temporarily restored, but we have a long way to go until attacks on reproductive freedom are stopped once and for all.

As we await a determination by the Supreme Court on May 11th, we know that these are the same far-right justices who chose to end the federal right to abortion just 4 years ago.

Democrats need to do everything we can to fight for our reproductive rights, especially under the Trump administration.

I’ve been saying it for years: ICE must be abolished to protect our communities.

Fighting back against Trump starts with getting his ICE agents out of our neighborhoods for good.

Abolish ICE now.

Video

Feeling inspired after May Day? Join us for one of our volunteer events this week to be a part of our people-powered campaign!

Whether you're on the ground in STL or supporting virtually, there’s a way for you to volunteer with Cori for US. This movement needs YOU to send a true fighter for St. Louis back to Congress.

I was proud to rally at Washington University on International Workers’ Day to support graduate workers and international students.

Higher education must serve the people. That means fully funding research and teaching, providing graduate workers with true livable wages, and ensuring that international students are protected from Trump’s violent and dehumanizing immigration enforcement crackdown.

Solidarity forever!
